description: Variant of the review of the commit that made a string mark a name only where a member's name is read: `self.omit = self.skipTest` assigns unittest's `skipTest` to an attribute; an assignment marks every identifier of its target, attributes included (`self`, `omit`), so head's `self.omit("x")` is a use of the vocabulary: at least a WARN that it may skip `TestA::test_adds`. The real runner skips it.
